title: LMentry: A Language Model Benchmark of Elementary Language Tasks
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark (LMentry) for evaluating large language models on elementary language tasks and robustness. While it discusses the broader context of LLM evaluation and cites papers that might touch upon ethical concerns or societal biases (e.g., in the related work section), the benchmark itself and the primary focus of the paper do not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core component. The tasks are low-level language abilities (e.g., word length, rhyming, sentence construction).
